Received

body.plain_text:
Dear Students,

The mid-semester examinations for the odd semester will begin on Monday,
19 October 2026. To help everyone prepare, the Office of Academic
Affairs will hold a short briefing on the examination rules and
logistics.

Briefing details:
  Date: Monday, 12 October 2026
  Time: 10:00-11:00 IST
  Venue: Seminar Hall A, Academic Block

Topics to be covered:
- Seating arrangement and hall allocation
- Identity card requirements for the examination hall
- Permitted calculators and stationery
- Procedure for requesting re-evaluation after results are declared

Attendance is strongly encouraged but not mandatory. Students who cannot
attend may collect a printed copy of the examination guidelines from the
Academic Affairs office during working hours.

Please carry your institute ID card to the session.

Regards,
Office of Academic Affairs
Northfield Institute of Technology
